page.description: Dishes guests put together from parts: a pizza half and half, three scoops of their choice.
page.emptyDescription: Like a half and half pizza, or three scoops of ice cream. It sits at the top of your menu.
page.removeDescription: Guests will no longer build {{dish}} this way. The dish stays on your menu.
page.atLimit: You have used every dish your package allows, and each build is a dish. Delete a dish to make another.
page.atBuildLimit_one: You have {{count}} build, as many as your restaurant may have. Delete it to make another.
page.atBuildLimit_other: You have {{count}} builds, as many as your restaurant may have. Delete one to make another.
page.offWhilePos: Off while your menu is connected to a POS. Your builds are kept and come back when you disconnect.

card.hiddenHint: Guests see it once at least 2 choices can be picked.

editor.leaveDescription: What you changed in this build will be lost.

pizza.name: A pizza, half and half
pizza.hint: One pizza with a different flavour on each part, picked from your pizzas.

pieces.name: Scoops or pieces
pieces.hint: Separate items picked one by one, like three scoops of ice cream.

other.name: Something else
other.hint: Anything else guests put together, like a mixed grill or two sides of their choice.

choices.label: Where the choices come from
choices.categoryHint: The dishes of one category, at the prices they already have.
choices.ownHint: Names and prices you write here, like flavours.
choices.noDishes: No dish in this category can be picked yet: it needs to be available and priced in {{currency}}.
choices.fewDishes: Guests see this build once at least 2 dishes here can be picked.
choices.listHint: 2 to {{max}} choices. Drag one to change the order guests see.
choices.tickHint: Untick a dish to leave it out of this build.
choices.fewTicked: Tick at least 2 dishes: guests see this build only then.
choices.noCategories: You have no categories yet. Add one with its dishes first, or type your own list above.

shapes.split: Like a pizza: one item in different parts

shapeHints.split: Each part can be a different choice, and costs its share.
shapeHints.pieces: Each piece is a whole item at its own price.

sizes.shareLine: Each part costs its share of the price: half of a 12.00 pizza is 6.00.
sizes.ownPricesHint: Want a part to cost something else, like a Margherita half at 7.00 instead of 6.00? Type it here. Leave a box empty to keep the price shown in it.

menu.name: Name on the menu
menu.iconHint: Shown beside its name at the top of your menu.

review.nothingYet: Add choices with a price to see what guests pay.

errors.dishNameRequired: Give the dish a name in {{language}}.
errors.choiceNameRequired: Give every choice a name in {{language}}.
errors.priceInvalid: Enter a price, or leave it empty.
